competitors.name: Rosina Food Products
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Rosina added five frozen meatball varieties, including Mini Meatballs, Bang-Bang Chicken Meatballs, High Protein Meatballs, Gluten-Free Restaurant Style Meatballs and Reduced Sodium Meatballs. The line targets convenience, protein, global flavor, gluten-free and reduced-sodium needs, with suggested retail prices of $7.99-$9.99.

competitors.name: Bertolli / Deoleo
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Bertolli launched Bertolli Canola + Olive Oil, an 85% canola oil and 15% Bertolli olive oil blend now available at Kroger nationwide and on Amazon, with broader retail rollout planned. Suggested prices are $6.99 for 25.36 fluid ounces and $9.99 for 50.72 fluid ounces.

competitors.name: Kroger
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Kroger's Q2 identical sales excluding fuel rose 0.2% as a cyclospora-related pullback in produce spending weighed on comps. Kroger lowered full-year identical-sales guidance to 0.2%-0.8%, while total Q2 sales rose 2% to $34.6 billion and operating profit rose more than 12% to $971 million.

trends.context: Frozen meal-adjacent brands are using protein, gluten-free, reduced-sodium and global-flavor claims to stay relevant beyond basic convenience. Premium pizza brands may face the same expectation that indulgent products also communicate functional or dietary benefits.

trends.magnitude: 85% canola / 15% olive oil blend at Kroger nationwide
trends.context: A major olive oil brand is using a lower-cost blended format to broaden household usage. For frozen pizza, this points to continued shopper and manufacturer sensitivity around premium Mediterranean ingredients and cost-managed formulation claims.

trends.magnitude: Kroger full-year identical-sales guidance cut to 0.2%-0.8%
trends.context: Even with digital and retail media growth, Kroger is managing weak comp sales and cautious fresh-food spending. Premium frozen and artisan CPG brands should expect tighter buyer scrutiny around velocity, trade support and value communication.
